summary: Preserved the candidate's valid trajectory-gate and regional-compile framework, independently reproduced and fixed its NaN fail-open behavior and tensor-valued terminal-state exception, and added adversarial regressions. The candidate still does not wire manifest resolution into a production server/request path and has no real diffusion or stateful world-model qualification, so this is a bounded correction rather than a complete implementation of the original feature.

tests.command: Exact-candidate adversarial invocation at b9fdebd698e93283f02acc4095f1fcda71233f4e (retained in raw/candidate_counterexamples.log)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: a NaN checkpoint and NaN output metric produced passed=True with no failures; equal tensor-valued terminal states raised RuntimeError because tensor truth value was ambiguous.
Passing-after focused compatibility and adversarial suite: 20 passed, including non-finite tensor/output rejection and nested tensor terminal-state structural comparison.

Real Inductor execution on one AMD Instinct MI350X: eager versus compiled four-step toy rollout passed with maximum absolute error 1.1920928955078125e-07; reset/short-history passed; deliberate step-1 perturbation was rejected.
Production wiring audit: the resolver and manifest APIs have no server/configuration/request consumer; DenoisingStage accepts an optional resolution but production callers omit it.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 ran the candidate's deterministic Linear/tanh Inductor trajectory. This does not qualify a diffusion or world-model architecture.
remaining_limitations: No production path loads a manifest, derives a current workload signature, resolves it, or passes resolved_plan to DenoisingStage; uncovered production requests are therefore not made eager by this feature.
No production model weights were available, so no real diffusion or stateful world-model trajectory was run and no architecture-specific source change is justified.
History regimes, cache on/off, CFG serial/parallel, reset isolation, mutation/alias metadata, distributed topology, and semantic output metrics remain unqualified.
The GPU test is a small Linear/tanh toy and does not exercise production DenoisingStage manifest enforcement or serving transport.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json declares no native build target, so native rebuilding was not applicable.
Torch emitted non-fatal Dynamo metrics JSON-serialization errors during the successful GPU execution.
